run_audiogoal_training: run the AudioGoalPredictorTrainer to train a model predicting audio goal labels and locations
test_audiogoal_evaluation: test the AudioGoalPredictorTrainer in eval mode on the test split with a saved checkpoint
create_trainer_instance: create an AudioGoalPredictorTrainer instance with config, model directory, and prediction flags
save_model_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint to the specified model directory during or after training
run_cli_training: run the audiogoal trainer CLI with --run-type train --predict-label --predict-location flags
